facts.value: The Career Service of Goethe University offers workshops every semester.
In these workshops, participants work intensively with their interests and goals, individual strengths, and professional profiles.
The Career Service supports students to familiarize themselves with various professional fields and identify individual strengths and interests.
Students can acquire important professional key competencies.
Questions about choosing study focus, internship fields, career perspectives with a bachelor’s degree, and whether to pursue a master’s degree are addressed.
The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' (BmB) allows students to network with renowned companies.
Students are recommended to look at the annually published career planner.
The Career Service offers various workshops on application training each semester.
Participants learn what is important when applying in the German and international job market.
Students can have their application documents checked by the Career Service.
Workshops and events are available to improve presentation skills and methodological knowledge.
